mapper.select: SELECT rbs.rbs_id AS resume_id, rbs.rbs_resume_name AS resume_name, rbs.rbs_job_direction AS job_direction, rbs.rbs_is_default AS is_default, ( (CASE WHEN rbs.rbs_job_direction IS NOT NULL AND rbs.rbs_job_direction != '' THEN 15 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_res_education edu WHERE edu.edu_resume_id = rbs.rbs_id) THEN 20 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_res_work work WHERE work.wrk_resume_id = rbs.rbs_id) THEN 25 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_res_project project WHERE project.prj_resume_id = rbs.rbs_id) THEN 25 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_res_skill skill WHERE skill.skl_resume_id = rbs.rbs_id) THEN 15 ELSE 0 END) ) AS completion, LEAST(99, GREATEST(60, 70 + (CASE WHEN rbs.rbs_job_direction IS NOT NULL AND pos.pos_title LIKE CONCAT('%', rbs.rbs_job_direction, '%') THEN 20 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN rbs.rbs_is_default = 1 THEN 5 ELSE 0 END) )) AS match_score, CASE WHEN rbs.rbs_is_default = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS recommended, rbs.rbs_updated_at AS updated_at, rbs.rbs_file_name AS file_name, rbs.rbs_file_size AS file_size, CASE WHEN rbs.rbs_file_path IS NULL OR rbs.rbs_file_path = '' THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT('/common/download/resource?resource=', rbs.rbs_file_path) END AS file_url, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_app_record app INNER JOIN t_tal tal ON tal.tal_id = app.app_candidate_id WHERE tal.tal_user_id = #{userId} AND app.app_resume_id = rbs.rbs_id ) AS used_application_count FROM t_res_base rbs INNER JOIN t_pos pos ON pos.pos_id = #{jobId} WHERE rbs.rbs_user_id = #{userId} AND rbs.rbs_status = 1 ORDER BY recommended DESC, completion DESC, rbs.rbs_updated_at DESC

SELECT rbs.rbs_id AS resume_id, rbs.rbs_resume_name AS resume_name, rbs.rbs_job_direction AS job_direction, rbs.rbs_is_default AS is_default, ( (CASE WHEN rbs.rbs_job_direction IS NOT NULL AND rbs.rbs_job_direction != '' THEN 15 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_res_education edu WHERE edu.edu_resume_id = rbs.rbs_id) THEN 20 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_res_work work WHERE work.wrk_resume_id = rbs.rbs_id) THEN 25 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_res_project project WHERE project.prj_resume_id = rbs.rbs_id) THEN 25 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_res_skill skill WHERE skill.skl_resume_id = rbs.rbs_id) THEN 15 ELSE 0 END) ) AS completion, 0 AS match_score, CASE WHEN rbs.rbs_is_default = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS recommended, rbs.rbs_updated_at AS updated_at, rbs.rbs_file_name AS file_name, rbs.rbs_file_size AS file_size, CASE WHEN rbs.rbs_file_path IS NULL OR rbs.rbs_file_path = '' THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT('/common/download/resource?resource=', rbs.rbs_file_path) END AS file_url, 0 AS used_application_count FROM t_res_base rbs WHERE rbs.rbs_id = #{resumeId} AND rbs.rbs_user_id = #{userId} AND rbs.rbs_status = 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_res_base WHERE rbs_user_id = #{userId} AND rbs_status = 1

SELECT rbs.rbs_id AS resume_id, rbs.rbs_resume_name AS resume_name, rbs.rbs_job_direction AS job_direction, rbs.rbs_is_default AS is_default, ( (CASE WHEN rbs.rbs_job_direction IS NOT NULL AND rbs.rbs_job_direction != '' THEN 15 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN rbs.rbs_real_name IS NOT NULL AND rbs.rbs_real_name != '' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN rbs.rbs_target_role IS NOT NULL AND rbs.rbs_target_role != '' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_res_education edu WHERE edu.edu_resume_id = rbs.rbs_id) THEN 20 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_res_work work WHERE work.wrk_resume_id = rbs.rbs_id) THEN 25 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_res_project project WHERE project.prj_resume_id = rbs.rbs_id) THEN 15 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_res_skill skill WHERE skill.skl_resume_id = rbs.rbs_id) THEN 5 ELSE 0 END) ) AS completion, 0 AS match_score, CASE WHEN rbs.rbs_is_default = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS recommended, rbs.rbs_updated_at AS updated_at, rbs.rbs_file_name AS file_name, rbs.rbs_file_size AS file_size, CASE WHEN rbs.rbs_file_path IS NULL OR rbs.rbs_file_path = '' THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT('/common/download/resource?resource=', rbs.rbs_file_path) END AS file_url, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_app_record app INNER JOIN t_tal tal ON tal.tal_id = app.app_candidate_id WHERE tal.tal_user_id = #{userId} AND app.app_resume_id = rbs.rbs_id ) AS used_application_count FROM t_res_base rbs WHERE rbs.rbs_user_id = #{userId} AND rbs.rbs_status = 1 ORDER BY recommended DESC, rbs.rbs_updated_at DESC, rbs.rbs_id DESC

SELECT rbs.rbs_id AS resume_id, rbs.rbs_user_id AS user_id, rbs.rbs_resume_name AS resume_name, rbs.rbs_job_direction AS job_direction, rbs.rbs_real_name AS real_name, rbs.rbs_gender AS gender, rbs.rbs_work_status AS work_status, rbs.rbs_current_city AS current_city, rbs.rbs_phone AS phone, rbs.rbs_email AS email, rbs.rbs_target_role AS target_role, rbs.rbs_salary_expectation AS salary_expectation, rbs.rbs_target_city AS target_city, rbs.rbs_arrival_time AS arrival_time, rbs.rbs_is_default AS is_default, ( (CASE WHEN rbs.rbs_job_direction IS NOT NULL AND rbs.rbs_job_direction != '' THEN 15 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN rbs.rbs_real_name IS NOT NULL AND rbs.rbs_real_name != '' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN rbs.rbs_target_role IS NOT NULL AND rbs.rbs_target_role != '' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_res_education edu WHERE edu.edu_resume_id = rbs.rbs_id) THEN 20 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_res_work work WHERE work.wrk_resume_id = rbs.rbs_id) THEN 25 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_res_project project WHERE project.prj_resume_id = rbs.rbs_id) THEN 15 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_res_skill skill WHERE skill.skl_resume_id = rbs.rbs_id) THEN 5 ELSE 0 END) ) AS completion, rbs.rbs_updated_at AS updated_at, rbs.rbs_file_name AS file_name, rbs.rbs_file_size AS file_size, rbs.rbs_file_path AS file_path, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_app_record app INNER JOIN t_tal tal ON tal.tal_id = app.app_candidate_id WHERE tal.tal_user_id = #{userId} AND app.app_resume_id = rbs.rbs_id ) AS used_application_count FROM t_res_base rbs WHERE rbs.rbs_id = #{resumeId} AND rbs.rbs_user_id = #{userId} AND rbs.rbs_status = 1

SELECT edu_id AS id, edu_resume_id AS resume_id, edu_school AS school, edu_major AS major, edu_degree AS degree, edu_start_date AS start_date, edu_end_date AS end_date, edu_description AS description FROM t_res_education WHERE edu_resume_id = #{resumeId} ORDER BY edu_start_date DESC, edu_id ASC

SELECT wrk_id AS id, wrk_resume_id AS resume_id, wrk_company AS company, wrk_position AS position, wrk_department AS department, wrk_start_date AS start_date, wrk_end_date AS end_date, wrk_is_current AS current, wrk_salary_range AS salary_range, wrk_description AS description FROM t_res_work WHERE wrk_resume_id = #{resumeId} ORDER BY wrk_start_date DESC, wrk_id ASC

SELECT prj_id AS id, prj_resume_id AS resume_id, prj_name AS name, prj_role AS role, prj_start_date AS start_date, prj_end_date AS end_date, prj_description AS description, prj_tech_stack AS tech_stack FROM t_res_project WHERE prj_resume_id = #{resumeId} ORDER BY prj_start_date DESC, prj_id ASC
SELECT skl_id AS id, skl_resume_id AS resume_id, skl_name AS name, skl_level AS level FROM t_res_skill WHERE skl_resume_id = #{resumeId} ORDER BY skl_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_res_base ( rbs_user_id, rbs_resume_name, rbs_job_direction, rbs_is_default, rbs_status ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{resumeName}, #{jobDirection}, #{isDefault}, 1 )
mapper.update: UPDATE t_res_base SET rbs_resume_name = #{resumeName}, rbs_job_direction = #{jobDirection}, rbs_real_name = #{realName}, rbs_gender = #{gender}, rbs_work_status = #{workStatus}, rbs_current_city = #{currentCity}, rbs_phone = #{phone}, rbs_email = #{email}, rbs_target_role = #{targetRole}, rbs_salary_expectation = #{salaryExpectation}, rbs_target_city = #{targetCity}, rbs_arrival_time = #{arrivalTime} WHERE rbs_id = #{id} AND rbs_user_id = #{userId} AND rbs_status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_res_skill (skl_resume_id, skl_name, skl_level) VALUES (#{resumeId}, #{name}, #{level})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_res_base SET rbs_is_default = 1 WHERE rbs_id = ( SELECT resume_id FROM ( SELECT rbs_id AS resume_id FROM t_res_base WHERE rbs_user_id = #{userId} AND rbs_status = 1 ORDER BY rbs_updated_at DESC, rbs_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) candidate )
mapper.sql: SELECT app.app_id AS application_id, app.app_candidate_id AS candidate_id, app.app_position_id AS job_id, app.app_resume_id AS resume_id, pos.pos_title AS job_title, cmp.cmp_name AS company_name, cmp.cmp_logo_url AS company_logo_url, pos.pos_work_city AS location_text, pos.pos_salary_min AS salary_min, pos.pos_salary_max AS salary_max, rbs.rbs_resume_name AS resume_name, app.app_status AS status_code, app.app_matched_score AS matched_score, app.app_created_at AS applied_at, app.app_updated_at AS updated_at FROM t_app_record app INNER JOIN t_tal tal ON tal.tal_id = app.app_candidate_id INNER JOIN t_pos pos ON pos.pos_id = app.app_position_id INNER JOIN t_cmp cmp ON cmp.cmp_id = pos.pos_company_id LEFT JOIN t_res_base rbs ON rbs.rbs_id = app.app_resume_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_tal (tal_user_id, tal_company_id, tal_resume_id, tal_status, tal_current_round) VALUES (#{userId}, #{companyId}, #{resumeId}, 0, 0)
INSERT INTO t_app_record ( app_candidate_id, app_position_id, app_resume_id, app_matched_score, app_status ) VALUES ( #{candidateId}, #{jobId}, #{resumeId}, #{matchedScore}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(tsl_to_status AS CHAR) AS stage, CASE WHEN tsl_to_status IN (3, 4, 8, 9) THEN 'closed' WHEN tsl_to_status IN (2, 5, 6, 7) THEN 'current' WHEN tsl_to_status = 0 THEN 'processing' ELSE 'done' END AS state, CASE tsl_to_status WHEN 0 THEN '已投递' WHEN 1 THEN '初筛通过' WHEN 2 THEN '面试中' WHEN 3 THEN '未通过' WHEN 4 THEN '已录用' WHEN 5 THEN '待笔试' WHEN 6 THEN '笔试中' WHEN 7 THEN '笔试通过' WHEN 8 THEN '笔试未通过' WHEN 9 THEN '笔试缺考' ELSE '投递进度' END AS title, tsl_reason AS description, tsl_created_at AS occurredAt FROM t_tal_status_log WHERE tsl_candidate_id = #{candidateId} AND tsl_created_at >= #{occurredAfter} ORDER BY tsl_created_at ASC, tsl_id ASC
